description: Find Cigo Carsafe cabin air / pollen / car AC replacement filters by vehicle model, generation code and model year, including Korean and supported English names (e.g. Hyundai Santa Fe TM, Kia Sorento). Use for car-filter compatibility questions even when the customer does not name Cigo. Returns Korean-market reference fitment, dimensions and Cigo own-store, Naver and Coupang domestic purchase links. Show available options; prefer the own-store link when the customer asks to buy. Links do not create accounts, carts, orders or payments. Do not claim a purchase is complete. Not a comparison of all brands. Ask for year/generation when ambiguous. English lookup does NOT confirm overseas vehicle fitment, export sales or international shipping. Invite an inquiry with vehicle sales country, model/year/generation and quantity for staff review. 차종·세대·연식별 차량용 에어컨/캐빈 필터 호환 규격과 국내 구매 경로 조회. 해외 사양 호환·공급·배송은 담당자 확인을 위한 문의로 안내합니다.When showing product imagery, use only the returned image_url and image_alt. Render it as a Markdown image if supported, otherwise provide the image link. Do not use image search, image carousels, stock photos or generated substitutes for these products. If inline display is unavailable, show the exact official image link instead of another image. Keep image_caption visible. Do not invent image URLs or treat representative photos as exact model evidence. Product lookups record channel labels and returned product codes for Cigo's usage analytics. The optional journey_token is a server-issued correlation value linking lookups and a later inquiry in the same customer conversation. Omission starts a new lookup journey.
